overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to hold a special meeting to consider an early start resolution for the 2027-2028 school year and approve a consent agenda covering personnel matters including appointments, separations, leaves of absence, and retirements. The early start resolution was the primary substantive item on the agenda.

agenda.item: Resolution of Starting School Prior to September 1 for the 2027-2028 School Year (Action Requested)

discussions.item: Resolution of Starting School Prior to September 1 for the 2027-2028 School Year
discussions.body: Diana White was scheduled to present an early start resolution for the 2027-2028 school year for board consideration. The presentation was estimated to take 5 minutes. The board was expected to vote on whether to authorize the school district to begin classes before September 1 in that school year.

The board was expected to approve a consent agenda encompassing four personnel categories: appointments of additional and replacement staff with contract increases, separations including resignations and contract decreases, leaves of absence, and retirements. The consent agenda was compiled and presented for a single vote on all items.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to vote on the Early Start Resolution for the 2027-2028 school year
